items.operation: Post-publication nine-path GitHub tree reconciliation for BASELINE-0030
items.failure: The first GitHub Trees API URL interpolated $commit?recursive as one PowerShell variable and returned HTTP 404 after all nine anonymous raw files had already matched by length and SHA-256.
items.correction: The successor resolved the exact tree SHA first and used ${treeSha}?recursive=1; all nine GitHub blob identities and sizes then matched local Git exactly.

items.operation: Resolve the local starting tree for the preimplementation receipt
items.failure: An unquoted HEAD^{tree} revision expression was interpreted by Windows PowerShell and passed an encoded fragment to Git, producing an ambiguous-argument error alongside unusable wrapper output.
items.correction: The successor passed the revision expression as the literal string 'HEAD^{tree}' and resolved tree c36fd5b9d98c6b6049ee0e0f7ef99a1bb9fdfaa0.

items.operation: Reconcile the newly pushed preimplementation branch across local and remote refs
items.failure: The first wrapper asked Git for @{upstream}, but the repository's narrow fetch configuration had not stored the newly pushed branch as a remote-tracking ref despite push reporting upstream setup.
items.correction: The successor explicitly fetched refs/heads/codex/baseline-0031-bounded-trust-tier-retrieval to the matching origin remote-tracking ref, then verified local, tracking, ls-remote, anonymous GitHub ref, commit, tree, all sixteen Git tree entries, and all sixteen anonymous raw files exactly.

items.operation: Advance the governed milestone from UNIT-001 to UNIT-002
items.failure: The first lifecycle edit used status 'completed', while the installed governed milestone contract requires the exact terminal status 'complete'. The validator rejected UNIT-001 and opened no additional authority.
items.correction: Use the validator's exact 'complete' status for UNIT-001 and rerun the governed milestone gate before publication or implementation.

items.failure: A compact PowerShell wrapper omitted token-separating spaces around -ne and -or, so it compared unintended variable names and emitted only a false ref-mismatch result.
items.correction: Use explicit parenthesized comparisons with separated PowerShell operators and report each ref identity on mismatch.

items.failure: The corrected comparison proved ls-remote already pointed to 401387f42940f78a037718eb41e1936d3b9f1d2c while the narrow-fetch remote-tracking ref still pointed to a7e42589b8e85d6f967128d32d7cea7a5111c3e9.
items.correction: Explicitly fetch the exact branch ref after every push in this worktree. The successor advanced tracking to 401387f42940f78a037718eb41e1936d3b9f1d2c and verified local, tracking, ls-remote, anonymous GitHub ref and tree APIs, all nine Git tree entries, and all nine anonymous raw files exactly.
